Kill [[Kanaxai]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Kanaxai in [[the Deep]].
* *BONUS* Kill Kanaxai in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*15,000 [[Experience]]
*2,000 [[Gold]]
*7,500 [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Completing this quest requires completion of [[the Deep]], an elite mission. See that mission's article for details.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Bounty
:''"Kill Kanaxai in the Deep."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Trivia==
*This was the first [[Zaishen Bounty]] quest when it was released as part of the [[Game updates/20090423|Guild Wars 4th Anniversary Celebration]] update on 23rd April 2009.
